scope: Corollary 9 of the manuscript “Choiceless polynomial time with counting does not capture polynomial time” (preprints/Choiceless-polynomial-time-with-counting-does-not-capture-polynomial-time-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 243 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 3e16a83bb7707c83), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 14. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let X be an H-invariant, membership-transitive finite family of hereditarily finite objects over Ab, and suppose |X| ≤ Nq for some fixed q ≥ 0. Every object in X, including every recursive constituent of each of its members, has a K-support of length at most 2L(q log3 N)2. All these supports can be padded to the common positive length s = l 2L(q log3 N + 1)2 m + 1 = Oq L(1 + log L)2 . (14)
